Wisconsin Democratic Primary Features Ideological Clash

Wisconsin voters are heading to the polls for a Democratic primary election for governor. The race features a contest between different ideologies within the party, notably a democratic socialist candidate who is a front-runner and the governor's pick. Moderates in the state are reportedly hoping to block the democratic socialist candidate. The primary is seen as a test of whether a democratic socialist can challenge the political establishment.
